title: Bicriteria Algorithms for Submodular Cover with Partition and Fairness Constraints

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the "fairness difference" (the gap between the maximum and minimum proportional representation of groups) of subset selection algorithms across different user language partitions in a Twitch gamers network dataset.

Measuring the fairness difference in the distribution of image labels/classes for subsets selected by the proposed algorithms on the Corel5k and ImageNet datasets, ensuring balanced representation across synthetic or predefined image categories.
